ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity (black) pixels comprising the remaining 15% concentrated at the edges and in discrete interior clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity (black) band along the entire trailing edge border. Numerous discrete, roughly circular low-intensity blobs (3-15 pixels in diameter) are distributed across the high-intensity field, with higher density in the distal regions of both lobes and the upper-medial region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 25-30 degrees with a vertical pixel depth approximately 1/10th the vertical span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude (2-5 pixel) serrations along the trailing edge. Distinct peaks and valleys are visible, with increased amplitude at the distal-most sections of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a smooth convex curvature tapering distally. The trailing edge follows a mildly concave trajectory from the median notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to convex near the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular, high-contrast dark pixel clusters across the white field, notably concentrated in the upper-medial region of the right lobe and the upper-distal region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast grey linear streaks oriented diagonally on the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, high-contrast, textured protrusion at the distal tip of the right lobe (barnacle colonization). Visible yellowish-brown pixel staining (diatom film) in the lower-medial regions near the peduncle transition.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 'Y-shaped' dark pigment mark located in the lower-central region of the fluke, immediately superior to the water-line interface.
